vibe: premium dark-blue tech agency: glowing kinetic typography on the chest, mixed sans + display serif, neon UI graphics
notes: Design system: styles/blue-glow-design-system.md (read before every edit)
No running subtitles: show each phrase as kinetic 2-tier text (small white sans kicker + big glowing serif/rounded-sans hero word) on the chest, ~58-62% height
Text sits BEHIND hands/person (AI cut-out), letters reveal in random order with blur+glow, exit by random letter dissolve or 4-frame fade
Hero word: horizontal gradient cyan #54BAE6 -> #6CD6E8 -> white-grey #CCDBE4 + soft outer glow; gold #FFE14A gradient only for 'premium/quality' words
Every 6-8s cut to a full-screen navy grid 'graphic scene' via vertical motion-blur push; return the same way
Sound: sub-bass boom on every scene change and big reveal, sparkle/shimmer on gold or emoji reveals, soft ticks on UI; no music bed (or very low)
Open with 0.2s blur-to-sharp focus pull; occasional 1.08-1.12x punch-in jump cuts
